verses.primary: If any man’s work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
verses.secondary: If any man’s work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.

verses.primary: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
verses.secondary: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.

verses.primary: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
verses.secondary: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

verses.primary: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
verses.secondary: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

verses.primary: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
verses.secondary: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

verses.primary: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
verses.secondary: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

verses.primary: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
verses.secondary: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

verses.primary: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
verses.secondary: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

verses.primary: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
verses.secondary: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

verses.primary: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
verses.secondary: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

verses.primary: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
verses.secondary: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

verses.primary: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
verses.secondary: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

verses.primary: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
verses.secondary: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

verses.primary: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verses.secondary: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

verses.primary: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
verses.secondary: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

verses.primary: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
verses.secondary: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

verses.primary: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.secondary: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

verses.primary: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
verses.secondary: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

verses.primary: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
verses.secondary: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)

verses.primary: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.secondary: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

verses.primary: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
verses.secondary: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

verses.primary: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.secondary: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

verses.primary: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
verses.secondary: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

verses.primary: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.secondary: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

verses.primary: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.secondary: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

verses.primary: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.secondary: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

verses.primary: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
verses.secondary: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

verses.primary: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
verses.secondary: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

verses.primary: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.secondary: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the Lord their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

verses.primary: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
verses.secondary: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

verses.primary: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:
verses.secondary: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the Lord carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the Lord to anger:

verses.primary: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
verses.secondary: For they served idols, whereof the Lord had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.

verses.primary: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
verses.secondary: Yet the Lord testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

verses.primary: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.
verses.secondary: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the Lord their God.

verses.primary: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.
verses.secondary: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the Lord had charged them, that they should not do like them.

verses.primary: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
verses.secondary: And they left all the commandments of the Lord their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

verses.primary: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
verses.secondary: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

verses.primary: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.secondary: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

verses.primary: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
verses.secondary: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

verses.primary: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.secondary: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

verses.primary: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.secondary: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

verses.primary: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.
verses.secondary: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

verses.primary: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
verses.secondary: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

verses.primary: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
verses.secondary: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

verses.primary: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.secondary: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

verses.primary: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:
verses.secondary: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar–adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

verses.primary: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man’s house burnt he with fire.
verses.secondary: And he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man’s house burnt he with fire.

verses.primary: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.secondary: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

verses.primary: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away.
verses.secondary: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carry away.

verses.primary: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.secondary: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

verses.primary: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.secondary: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

verses.primary: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
verses.secondary: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

verses.primary: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
verses.secondary: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

verses.primary: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
verses.secondary: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

verses.primary: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
verses.secondary: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

verses.primary: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
verses.secondary: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

verses.primary: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.secondary: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

verses.primary: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
verses.secondary: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

verses.primary: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.secondary: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

verses.primary: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.secondary: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

verses.primary: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.secondary: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

verses.primary: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
verses.secondary: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

verses.primary: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
verses.secondary: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

verses.primary: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verses.secondary: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

verses.primary: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
verses.secondary: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

verses.primary: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.secondary: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.primary: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
verses.secondary: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

verses.primary: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
verses.secondary: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

verses.primary: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
verses.secondary: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

verses.primary: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
verses.secondary: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

verses.primary: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.secondary: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

verses.primary: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.secondary: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

verses.primary: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
verses.secondary: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

verses.primary: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.secondary: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

verses.primary: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.secondary: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

verses.primary: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.secondary: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

verses.primary: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
verses.secondary: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

verses.primary: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
verses.secondary: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

verses.primary: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
verses.secondary: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.

verses.primary: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
verses.secondary: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

verses.primary: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.secondary: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

verses.primary: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.secondary: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

verses.primary: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.secondary: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

verses.primary: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
verses.secondary: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

verses.primary: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
verses.secondary: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

verses.primary: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
verses.secondary: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

verses.primary: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
verses.secondary: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

verses.primary: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
verses.secondary: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

verses.primary: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
verses.secondary: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

verses.primary: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.
verses.secondary: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

verses.primary: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
verses.secondary: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

verses.primary: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
verses.secondary: And the Lord shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the Lord thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:

verses.primary: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
verses.secondary: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

verses.primary: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
verses.secondary: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

verses.primary: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
verses.secondary: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

verses.primary: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.secondary: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

verses.primary: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
verses.secondary: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

verses.primary: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
verses.secondary: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

verses.primary: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
verses.secondary: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

verses.primary: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

verses.secondary: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

verses.primary: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
verses.secondary: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

verses.primary: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
verses.secondary: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

verses.primary: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
verses.secondary: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

verses.primary: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.secondary: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

verses.primary: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
verses.secondary: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

verses.primary: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.secondary: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.primary: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.secondary: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

verses.primary: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verses.secondary: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

verses.primary: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.secondary: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

verses.primary: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
verses.secondary: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

verses.primary: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;
verses.secondary: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;

verses.primary: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
verses.secondary: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:

verses.primary: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.secondary: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

verses.primary: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
verses.secondary: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.

verses.primary: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.secondary: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

verses.primary: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.secondary: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

verses.primary: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den.
verses.secondary: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den.

verses.primary: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.secondary: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.

verses.primary: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
verses.secondary: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

verses.primary: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.secondary: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

verses.primary: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.secondary: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

verses.primary: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.secondary: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.

verses.primary: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.secondary: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

verses.primary: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
verses.secondary: And the Lord shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.

verses.primary: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.secondary: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.primary: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.secondary: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

verses.primary: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
verses.secondary: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

verses.primary: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.secondary: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

verses.primary: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, and the excellency of our God.
verses.secondary: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the Lord, and the excellency of our God.

verses.primary: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD; and there is none else.
verses.secondary: For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord; and there is none else.

verses.primary: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.secondary: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

verses.primary: And these are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.secondary: And these are the words that the Lord spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

verses.primary: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.secondary: For thus saith the Lord; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

verses.primary: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.secondary: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

verses.primary: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble, but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.secondary: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

verses.primary: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
verses.secondary: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

verses.primary: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:
verses.secondary: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the Lord:

verses.primary: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.secondary: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the Lord, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

verses.primary: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
verses.secondary: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the Lord: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

verses.primary: Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name:
verses.secondary: Thus saith the Lord, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The Lord of hosts is his name:

verses.primary: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
verses.secondary: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the Lord, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.

verses.primary: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
verses.secondary: Thus saith the Lord; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the Lord.

verses.primary: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.secondary: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

verses.primary: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.secondary: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

verses.primary: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.secondary: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

verses.primary: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.secondary: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

verses.primary: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.secondary: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

verses.primary: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.secondary: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

verses.primary: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
verses.secondary: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

verses.primary: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.secondary: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

verses.primary: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.secondary: And he shall wave the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

verses.primary: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.secondary: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

verses.primary: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.secondary: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

verses.primary: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
verses.secondary: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

verses.primary: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
verses.secondary: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

verses.primary: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
verses.secondary: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

verses.primary: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.secondary: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

verses.primary: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.secondary: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

verses.primary: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
verses.secondary: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

verses.primary: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.secondary: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

verses.primary: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.secondary: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

verses.primary: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
verses.secondary: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

verses.primary: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.secondary: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

verses.primary: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.secondary: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

verses.primary: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.secondary: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

verses.primary: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.secondary: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

verses.primary: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.secondary: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

verses.primary: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.secondary: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

verses.primary: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.secondary: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

verses.primary: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
verses.secondary: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

verses.primary: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
verses.secondary: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

verses.primary: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.secondary: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

verses.primary: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.secondary: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

verses.primary: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.secondary: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

verses.primary: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.secondary: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

verses.primary: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.secondary: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

verses.primary: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
verses.secondary: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

verses.primary: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.secondary: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

verses.primary: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
verses.secondary: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

verses.primary: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.secondary: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

verses.primary: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.secondary: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

verses.primary: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.secondary: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

verses.primary: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.secondary: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

verses.primary: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
verses.secondary: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

verses.primary: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.secondary: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

verses.primary: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.secondary: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

verses.primary: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.secondary: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

verses.primary: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
verses.secondary: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

verses.primary: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.secondary: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

verses.primary: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.secondary: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

verses.primary: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
verses.secondary: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

verses.primary: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.secondary: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

verses.primary: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.secondary: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.primary: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.secondary: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

verses.primary: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.secondary: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

verses.primary: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.secondary: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

verses.primary: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.secondary: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

verses.primary: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.secondary: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

verses.primary: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.secondary: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

verses.primary: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
verses.secondary: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

verses.secondary: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.primary: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.secondary: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

verses.primary: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.secondary: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.

verses.primary: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.secondary: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

verses.primary: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.secondary: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

verses.primary: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
verses.secondary: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

verses.primary: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
verses.secondary: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

verses.primary: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.secondary: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

verses.primary: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
verses.secondary: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

verses.primary: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
verses.secondary: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

verses.primary: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
verses.secondary: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

verses.primary: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
verses.secondary: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

verses.primary: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
verses.secondary: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

verses.primary: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
verses.secondary: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

verses.primary: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
verses.secondary: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

verses.primary: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.secondary: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

verses.primary: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
verses.secondary: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
